work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter L to Archbishop Antonio Nurigian (address LF9110–9112) on Armenian liturgical disputes; body LF9118–9152 and 2 August 1835 closing LF9154–9157 on the left column of artifact page 72; its own note 1 at the foot of the same page (LF9211–9231 left, LF9234–9252 right) is retained. The right-column brief LI LF9160–9208 between them is a different act and is not selected. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF9115–9115; the source closing at LF9154–9157 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die secunda augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pon- tificatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
